nodes.title: קטע E
nodes.body_he: קראו פעם אחת בלי לעצור על כל מילה. אחר כך השאלות.
nodes.body_content: When a town moves its market from the square to a closed hall, it solves the rain and creates a new problem. People who came for tomatoes now walk past shops that sell the same tomatoes in plastic boxes at a higher price. The hall is clean. It is also far from the bus, so older buyers stop coming. A reporter spent three Saturdays there. She counted empty stalls before nine and a queue at the one stall that still sold loose fruit. The owner, Nira, refused the plastic boxes. She said her customers know how to choose a peach. The council calls the hall a success because the rent is paid. Nira calls it a room that forgot the street.
